# Rapier 3D compat

Vendored from the official npm package `@dimforge/rapier3d-compat@0.20.0`.
`rapier.mjs` is the unmodified published ES module including its WebAssembly payload.
No network request is needed at runtime.

- Source: https://github.com/dimforge/rapier.js
- Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/@dimforge/rapier3d-compat/-/rapier3d-compat-0.20.0.tgz
- License: Apache-2.0, in `LICENSE`.
- API documentation: https://rapier.rs/javascript3d/
